description: One request or private order by id: direction, base amount and asset, quote asset, ask price (null when none was set), visibility, status and expiry. Anyone holding the id can read it, which is how a private order's link works. An unknown id returns an error. To browse use list_open_rfqs; for your own use my_rfqs.
